strategies.name: premarket_level_breakout_or_retest_continuation
strategies.entry_summary: Mark the pre-market high and low from 3:00 a.m. EST to the 9:30 a.m. open on the 5-minute chart. Enter in the direction of a confirmed break of that level after a solid close above/below it; either buy/sell the breakout close on a lower timeframe with elevated volume, or wait for price to retest the
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop on the opposite side of the entry/breakout candle or just below/above the reclaimed level on the retest. Target at least 1R, ideally 1.5R to 2R, then trim/scale out and trail the stop to break-even or into profit as the trade moves in your favor.

strategies.name: premarket_level_liquidity_sweep_reversal
strategies.entry_summary: After marking the pre-market high/low, wait for price to briefly break or wick through the level and then reclaim it, signaling a failed breakout and liquidity sweep. result.enumeration_note: The video teaches two distinct skeletons: continuation on confirmed break/retest, and opposite-direction reversal on a liquidity sweep reclaim. The breakout-close and break-and-retest entries are compatible variants of one continuation strategy because they share the same directional logic and management.
